description:
With midterm elections less than a month away, what do Americans think about where the country has been and where it is heading? Watch the prologue for “American Voices 2026,” the latest installment of FRONTLINE’s documentary project chronicling the views and experiences of U.S. voters from 2020 through the present.
 
This journalism is made possible by viewers like you. Donate to FRONTLINE now: https://bit.ly/47DFzCb
 
And support your local PBS station here: https://www.pbs.org/donate

The full documentary premieres Tues., Oct. 13, 2026, on PBS and online. 

Learn more: https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/frontline/documentary/american-voices/
 
“American Voices 2026” is a FRONTLINE Production with Mike Shum Productions. The director is Mike Shum. The producers are Tarryn Mento and Mike Shum. The writers are Hillary Bachelder & Mike Shum.
